approval.designAndTestPlan: Approved by the owner on 2026-10-19: proceed with the proposed design, complete regression and three independent rendered review rounds through a local Release candidate.

release.reason: This proposal selects navigation behavior; a new public release endpoint has not been requested.

coverage: Files and Outline switching preserves document, scroll position and search state
explicit folder choice, lazy directory expansion, filtering, sorting and root containment
Unicode and space-containing paths, symbolic links, inaccessible and missing folders
same-window file navigation, duplicate-window activation, Back and relative links outside the selected root
directory updates, additions, removals and replacement saves without broad indexing
nested, skipped-level, duplicate and Unicode headings with rendered anchor identity
outline selection follows scrolling and updates after saves without stale revision events
empty files and folders, missing headings and failure/recovery states
sidebar visibility, resizing, saved preferences and narrow-window collapse
480pt and 640pt windows, 200% document zoom, light and dark appearances
actual keyboard input, focus transfer, menu toggle and VoiceOver navigation
existing opening routes, search, copy, zoom, diagrams, math, images, refresh, security and source immutability
fixed 100KiB documents, 1MiB and 5MiB documents, and large folder/heading lists
matched baseline memory and latency with sidebar hidden, Files active and Outline active
normal Release build on the final verified candidate

uiReviewRounds.focus: Files, Outline, same-window navigation and Back
small windows, zoom, appearance, keyboard, VoiceOver and recovery
final integrated regression, refresh, stale results, memory and source immutability

evidence: Record exact candidate SHA, environment, actual actions, screenshots, logs and observed outcomes. Unexecuted or blocked checks remain unverified. The conceptual preview is not product runtime evidence.
implementationTesting: Add meaningful failing core and integration tests before behavior changes. Validate visual layout through the actual app rather than asserting implementation details.
